newsitem.title: UK: Aluminium moves to 19-month high, nickel strong.
newsitem.headline: Aluminium moves to 19-month high, nickel strong.

text.p: ALUMINIUM - Hits 19-month high of $1,712 a tonne on investment fund buying and short-covering following Tuesday's breach of $1,700. Forward selling helping to cap market, but upside targets of $1,725 and $1,750 expected later.
NICKEL - Strong above $7,500, continues to correct from oversold condition.
ZINC - Stable, cash/threes at around $100 backwardation.
